name: [⚔️] Merge Vs Mobs
desc:
🛡️ Welcome to Merge Vs Mobs!

⭐ Like the game and join the group for future updates!

⚔️ How to Play ⚔️

🛒 Buy Units to defend your base
👹 Defeat enemies to earn Coins and Gems
💰 Use Coins to buy more Units and grow stronger
🔀 Merge matching Units to create stronger ones
📚 Discover new enemies and powerful bosses
🔁 Rebirth to gain permanent boosts, progress through waves faster, and unlock even stronger units

🛠️ Developed by @PR7MIUM and @Seecretxs
👥 Join the group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/32001182/The-99-Percent
